scope: Independent CPU-only manual configuration/wording review, old-group overlap review and source patch inspection. No model, feature export, training, Unity, network or frozen-test motion outputs used.

resolved_findings.result: raise/both/forward/chest/hold excluded with all eight variants.
Three full lifts in total explicitly stated.
One slow/gentle/quick nod uses singular form.
Verified generator fixes: up=face/inward palm; down=below waist/downward palm; forward/outward/across=chest/upward palm. Freeze snapshot will be checked separately.
Verified generator states three full turns in total. Freeze snapshot will be checked separately.

old_2000_policy.val_test_meaning: retention audit, not semantically unseen holdout after this expansion
old_2000_policy.reason: Legacy groups partition family/side/amplitude/pace. New descriptions specify target/count/composition but often leave legacy amplitude/pace broad, so compatible semantics can overlap old validation/test groups.

concrete_examples.relationship: Compatible: new height/count does not exclude old unspecified target/count, and new text omits amplitude/pace.
Compatible: new count does not define amplitude, while old text leaves count unspecified.
Compatible: new counts alone do not separate old amplitude/pace configurations.

old_2000_policy.selection_claim: Old validation can constrain retention, but improvement on it or old test is not evidence of unseen-action generalization.

frozen_80_policy.meaning: Isolated complete configurations and expressions; shared primitives and legacy broad descriptions are allowed.

seen_diagnostics_policy: Four previously observed failure strings stay excluded verbatim; other overhead/explanation training semantics are allowed. Their improvement is known-issue regression only.
limits: Eight forms per group are surface variants, not 1984 independent actions.
Data labels specify intended motions, not observed teacher success or motion-capture ground truth.
Continuous words such as chest/face/shoulder and small/moderate remain fuzzy; final semantic evaluation requires manual review, not only height bands.
